title: Topology-aware token sharding and comm steering for prefill/decode
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Investigate and implement a topology-aware token sharding and work-steering layer that reduces prefill/decode tail latency by overlapping NCCL communication with compute and aligning token slices with PCIe/NIC topology. This ticket covers design, experiments, and a controlled rollout for the runtime optimizer that decides token slices, comm windows, and kernel selection hints per job.
proposal: Add a scheduler component (work-steering) that selects token shards per tensor-parallel rank based on node topology (NUMA/PCIe/NIC locality) and recent sequence-length distribution. The scheduler will compute comm windows and insert non-blocking NCCL collectives scheduled to start slightly earlier than the blocking point to hide latency. It will also emit kernel-selection hints (e.g., f32->q4f16-friendly kernels) when sharding patterns favor specific memory layouts.
technical_notes:
- Token sharding: prefer contiguous token slices per TP rank to optimize KV cache locality and reduce cross-rank scatter.
- Topology discovery: use existing node metadata (pci_bus_id, nvlink graph) to prefer intra-socket sharding when GPU-to-GPU nvlink exists; otherwise bias shards to minimize PCIe hops.
- Comm steering: schedule CUDA streams so NCCL launches N ms before the expected barrier, tuned per model family and sequence length.
- Kernel hints: provide the kernel selector with expected batch-sizes and slice offsets so it can pick tiling kernels that maintain coalesced loads for attention.
- Fallbacks: if topology info is missing or experiment toggled off, use current round-robin sharding and synchronous collectives.
acceptance_criteria: Automated scheduler can read node topology and produce per-request sharding decisions
End-to-end runtime supports non-blocking NCCL schedules emitted by the scheduler
Decode 95th percentile latency improves by >= 12% on internal eval traces vs baseline on heterogeneous 8xA100_80GB cluster
No regression in correctness (replay tests / determinism tests pass)
Feature guarded behind runtime flag and toggleable via console per-deployment
rollout_plan: 1) Internal experiment on canary infra with synthetic traces (1 week). 2) Small canary: enable for 5% of Dedicated clusters with telemetry. 3) Ramp to 25% for Mixed workloads if no regressions for 48h. 4) Full rollout with automatic rollback on latency or error spikes.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for topology parsing and sharding correctness.
- Integration tests to verify NCCL non-blocking launches interleave with compute streams.
- Perf harness: replay stored production traces and measure p50/p95/p99 for prefill and decode.
- Long-run stability test for 48h under sustained decode traffic.
- Compare KV cache hit rates and memory consumption against baseline.
